extracted.intended_audience: researchers preparing NIH grant applications (Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors), e.g., biosketch authors
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing NIH-formatted Biographical Sketches for Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors following the NIH/OMB template and page limits. Includes required sections (Personal Statement, Positions and Honors, Contributions to Science, Research Support) and specified fields for each person.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Biographical Sketch may not exceed five pages. Follow the formats and instructions below. (OMB No. 0925-0001/0002 (Rev. 08/12 Approved Through 8/31/2015))

rubrics_metrics.name: Required header fields (name, eRA Commons user name, position title)
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME: [Full name]  eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login):  POSITION TITLE: [Position]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include these identification fields at the top of the biographical sketch for each person.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training table
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each entry provide: INSTITUTION AND LOCATION, DEGREE (if applicable), Completion Date MM/YYYY, and FIELD OF STUDY. Begin with baccalaureate and include subsequent relevant training.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Personal Statement — A concise narrative describing the individual's research focus and relevance to the proposed project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a brief personal statement that explains how the person's background and expertise support their role on the application. Also explicitly list the 4 most relevant publications to this grant: "My 4 most relevant publications to this grant include:" followed by citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Honors — A chronological listing of positions, employment, and honors held by the individual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide dates and titles for positions and a list of honors; may also include other research experience, professional memberships, and other relevant service.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Contribution to Science — Numbered narrative descriptions of the individual's major scientific contributions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each contribution provide a short explanatory narrative and cite relevant publications that support the contribution (examples show lettered citations a., b., c., etc., with PMIDs/PMCIDs when available). Use contribution narratives to highlight discoveries, methods, models, or conceptual advances and include supporting citations and notes (e.g., 'Recommended by Faculty of 1000').

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support — List ongoing and pending research support for the individual
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate ongoing research support from pending research support. For each entry provide grant number, sponsor (e.g., NIH institute), project title/summary of Specific Aims, project dates, and the individual's role (e.g., PI). Note any overlap/non-overlap between aims and the current proposal where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include links to complete publication lists (MyNCBI)
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete list of published work in MyNCBI: [URL]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a link to the individual's MyNCBI bibliography for a complete list of publications (the example shows a MyNCBI URL with sorting parameters).

rubrics_metrics.name: State role on related grants and clarify overlap
rubrics_metrics.description: When listing research support, indicate the individual's role (e.g., PI) and explicitly state whether the aims overlap with the current proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example language: 'Role: PI' and 'The Specific Aims of this project are to ... The remaining Aims have no overlap with this proposal.' Use clear statements to avoid overlap/duplicate submission concerns.
